programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

Tracing its roots at a hot pot museum and experiencing mountain restaurants, we see its evolution from dockworkers' fare to a trendy lifestyle. programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - nokdu
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is risking city-pop songwriter nokdu! nokdu made his big debut in 2018 with the single Say My Name. As a graduate of The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts founded by Paul McCartney and Mark Featherstone-Witty he covers a wide range of genres in his music ranging from Brit-pop to punk to R&B. Backed up by his academic background he boasts his outstanding ability not only as a songwriter but also a lyricist producer and singer. Also known for his stage manners he is quickly capturing the ears and souls of countless listeners. Currently he's taking part in the competition program Super Band 2. His fantastic performance in the show definitely makes us anticipate his future as a musician. In this episode nokdu performs Stay With Me Wona and more to show off the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - WeAreYoung
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the sensual pop-duo WeAreYoung! Composed of keyboardist and vocalist KIM Kyung-min and guitarist and vocalist GU Ki-hoon this duo made themselves known to the public with their heartfelt songs about youth and love. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they won the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie Award the Silver Prize at the 2017 Martin Contest and Best Rookie at the Beautiful Mint Life 2018. This year they were chosen as recipients of the MUSE ON 2021 which aims to connect musicians and fans during the COVID-19 pandemic. Earlier this year WeAreYoung announced their much-anticipated comeback after completing their mandatory military duties and they are bound to impress once again with their songs A Day Full Of You Let's not do that Only I Love You and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - sogumm
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Lee Jin ah
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of Christmas Special Year-End Special and New-Year Special and the guest of the Christmas Special Episode is Lee Jin ah. Lee Jin ah is a pop/jazz singer-songwriter known for her exceptional piano playing and composition capabilities. Her jazz-based music covering pop R&B hip-hop ballads and more has long been supported with enthusiasm by the public and also by fellow musicians and she always comforts the hearts of listeners with her genuine heartfelt message. In an effort to widen her artistry she made her debut as a film music director in May this year she made her debut as a film music director with Kids Are Fine. In this Christmas special edition Lee Jin ah performs The Wall Blocks Me Noisily Everywhere Awake Yum Yum Yum and her own version of Santa Claus Is Coming To Town. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Juk Jae
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of the Christmas Special the Year-End Special and the New-Year Special and the guest of the New-Year Special Episode is Juk Jae. Juk Jae is a guitarist-turned-singer-songwriter known for his lyrical and ambient songs with a guitar sound. Since his debut in 2014 he has collaborated with numerous singers including IU and Zion T and has also released many hit songs but he is still determined to show his transformation and growth through music. As part of that effort he hosts the audio show “Juk Jae's Night Time Studio” and also went on his first concert tour across Korea in November last year. In this New-Year Special Edition Juk Jae performs “Let’s Go See The Stars” “Sky Dream” “One Another” and more to amaze our ears and souls. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Younha
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter Younha! Younha began her career in 2003 in Japan with her first single “ゆびきり.” Then she found mainstream success the following year with her second Japanese single “ほうき星 (Comet)” which was included on the soundtrack of the anime series “Bleach.” The song peaked on the Oricon Chart at #15 giving her the nickname of the “Oricon Comet.” Her success in the island country led to her debut in Korea as well; she debuted in Korea in 2016 where she is regarded as one of the country’s best singer-songwriters. From “Waiting” to “Password 486” Younha has many hit songs under her belt. She has also collaborated with numerous A-list musicians including Toy and Epik High. In November last year Younha released her sixth full-length album “END THEORY” to once again prove how versatile of a musician she is. From rock to ballad music she covered various genres in the album and the album’s lead single “Stardust” was chosen as one of Billboard’s Best K-pop Songs of the Year. In this episode Younha performs “Stardust” “Wish” “Waiting” “How U doing” and more to nourish our hearts. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kuonechan
programme.desc: Kuonechan is a rising star in Korean R&B circles known for his sweet voice and heartwarming music. After debuting in the music scene with the EP “Repetition” in September 2017 he diligently pursued his career releasing a total of three EPs within a year. He’s now actively collaborating with big names in the industry including Baek Yerin Jang Sukhoon Humbert and Fisherman and making his distinctive mark in the industry. This artist recently finished his mandatory military duties and announced a new chapter in his career. In this episode Kuonechan performs his new single “Expression” as well as “Don’t be sad” “How Did You” and more to nourish our souls. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ALi
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s I’m LIVE is singer ALi! ALi burst into the music scene in 2005 as a guest vocalist for Leessang. Thanks to her unique voice and expressive vocals she mesmerized the public immediately and then she made her debut as a solo artist in 2009 with the album “After The Love Has Gone.” In the competition program “Immortal Songs” she presented her own covers of various masterpieces including “Leopard of Kilimanjaro” and “I Have a Girlfriend” and gained both popular and critical acclaim. In December last year ALi released the remake album “Adolescence” which is composed of the five songs that had a huge influence on her back in her 20’s and 30’s to share with listeners how she makes the most of the youngest day of her life. In this episode ALi performs “For lovers who hesitate” “Break away” and “Please wait for me” from her latest album as well as “Eraser” and “The way the light.” Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Grizzly
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter Grizzly! This artist made his debut in the music industry in 2014 with his first single “D.S.” Since then he has been bringing soulful hits to our lives with his lifting vocals good vibes and aesthetically pleasing music combining R&B soul and pop. Thanks to his talents and passion he has collaborated with many big names in the industry including Dbo Khundi Panda Jaedal Punch nello SOLE and Coogie. On January 5 Grizzly made his way back to the charts with a love song called “Beige coat.” With lyrics about what a guy should do and prepare when he is on his way to meet someone he loves this new song is bound to immerse listeners deep into their feelings. In this episode Grizzly performs his new song “Beige coat” along with “Countryside” “Island” and more. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet his talented artist!

programme.desc: Pengisian slot: Nasihatul Tasnim merangkumi perkongsian ilmu Tauhid yang menyentuh aspek keimanan dan kehidupan seharian. Slot ini turut diserikan dengan segmen Muzik Ekspress – Rima yang menampilkan siaran lagu-lagu Irama Melayu pilihan. Seterusnya, BBMU (Bingkisan Buat Mu) membawakan dedikasi khas kepada pendengar, di samping penyampaian ucapan yang diterima melalui Facebook dan WhatsApp. Slot ini juga memuatkan hebahan terkini sebelum diakhiri dengan penutup yang ringkas dan bermakna.

programme.title: Santai 612
programme.desc: Pengisian slot: Nasihatul Tasnim merangkumi perkongsian ilmu Tauhid yang menyentuh aspek keimanan dan kehidupan seharian. Slot ini turut diserikan dengan segmen Muzik Ekspress – Rima yang menampilkan siaran lagu-lagu Irama Melayu pilihan. Seterusnya, BBMU (Bingkisan Buat Mu) membawakan dedikasi khas kepada pendengar, di samping penyampaian ucapan yang diterima melalui Facebook dan WhatsApp. Slot ini juga memuatkan hebahan terkini sebelum diakhiri dengan penutup yang ringkas dan bermakna.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets to play matchmaker when three fallow deer trade their bachelor days for life with a 120-strong female deer herd. But first Matt must dart the deer and remove their antlers -V so the pressure's really on. The abandoned baby badger has trebled in size, but back in the surgery, a tiny water dragon is in for a tricky operation. There's good news for two rescued stray cats when they find a luxury new home - and at Flamingoland, Matt lets the ring-tailed lemurs out into their brand new enclosure after a winter spent indoors.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes arranges a warrant to rescue four dogs from a dangerously overcrowded house. After an unfriendly welcome it becomes clear that at least one of the dogs will need medical attention but their diagnosis turns out much more serious than expected.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them. If you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \\\"ASEAN First\\\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \\\"ASEAN 2045\\\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: Ilmuan Islamiah
programme.desc: A programme exploring the development of various fields of knowledge pioneered and advanced by prominent Islamic scholars and thinkers. Each episode features two influential figures — a historical scholar and a contemporary thinker — highlighting their contributions, ideas and lasting impact on their respective fields.

programme.title: Iqra'
programme.desc: A Quran learning programme focused on talaqqi and guided Quran reading, helping viewers of all ages learn to read the Quran correctly with proper tajwid and pronunciation.

programme.title: Nawaitu
programme.desc: A programme exploring the importance of intention (niat) as the foundation of every action, through real-life stories and experiences within society. It highlights how sincere intentions can transform good deeds into acts of worship, while misguided intentions may lead to unintended consequences, guided by teachings from the Quran and Hadith.

programme.title: Kata Sifu
programme.desc: A mentorship programme featuring accomplished experts from selected fields as Sifus (mentors) who share their knowledge, skills and experience with their mentees. Hosted by Wanns Ahmad, the programme offers an engaging platform for learning, guidance and personal growth.

programme.title: Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring Malaysia’s heritage cities, showcasing their unique history, culture, natural attractions and interesting places for visitors to discover. Each episode takes viewers on a journey through the country’s heritage destinations and highlights experiences worth exploring.

programme.title: Warisan Kita
programme.desc: An engaging programme for general audiences that showcases Malaysia’s rich heritage, highlighting the country’s diverse cultural traditions, customs, arts and historical legacy.

programme.title: Etnik Kita
programme.desc: A travelogue following host Alif Hadi as he journeys across Malaysia to discover the lives, cultures and traditions of the country’s minority ethnic communities, offering viewers a closer look at their unique heritage and way of life.

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: ASEAN - RASA ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa Asean, is a culinary travel program involving the tastes of food from Asean countries with Chef Fikri and Chef Naim who will also produce and serve the stories behind the traditional food.

programme.title: Asean Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: Episode 1 features the stories and entrepreneurial journeys of three women entrepreneurs from ASEAN — Christy Ng (Malaysia), Boutsaya Viengviseth (Laos), and Nikha Akhsaniyati Kholisoh (Indonesia) — as they build their businesses, overcome challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.

programme.title: ASEAN - JEJAK HALAL ASEAN
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring the diverse cultures, traditions and everyday lives of Muslim communities across ASEAN. This episode of Jejak Halal ASEAN takes viewers on a journey through Satun, Thailand, discovering its rich Islamic heritage, halal culture and unique local way of life.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (TILAWAH)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme showcases beautiful and melodic recitations by participants from Bosnia Herzegovina, Kazakhstan, Canada and India reflecting the diversity and unity of the Muslim world through the art of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - SYAHADAH (UZBEKISTAN)

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: 早安 老时光
programme.desc: 每天 5点到6点，为您送上60-80 经典老歌，让你听出耳油！

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: Tech Me
programme.desc: A tech focused program with the latest updates on Tech news, Gaming and Gadgets. Every Monday at 12:15pm

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 孤芳自赏
programme.desc: 在快节奏与商业大片的喧喧嚷嚷之外，总有一些电影选择安静地立于角落，散发着独一无二的光芒。这里是《孤芳自赏》，一处专属于高冷影迷与独立电影的声音（视觉）放映厅。\n\n我们带你穿透繁复的光影，解读那些被低估的冷门佳作、艺术大师的独行之作，以及镜头深处最隐秘的人性角落。不追热门，不作媚俗之语。今夜，让我们在独立的光影世界里，孤芳自赏。

As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: A year after Jamie's wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.
